newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Gatic may sell assets to pay off bond.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Gatic may sell assets to pay off bond.

text.p: Gatic, manufacturer of Adidas AG, New Balance and other sportswear under license in Argentina, said Thursday it may sell assets in order to meet payments of $37 million on a Eurobond that matured Monday but it failed to pay off.
Abraham Aharonian, administration director at Gatic, told Reuters, "We will most likely sell assets to face this situation."
"Since industrial assets cannot be sold off rapidly we are talking to the (underwriting) banks, seeking loans guaranteed by the sale or the handing over of the assets directly to the banks," he said.
Negotiations with the bond underwriters, Standard Chartered and Argentine Banco Comafi, are making headway, he said. "We will have decided on the strategy within the next 30 days," added Aharonian.

Gatic failed to meet capital payments on the due date of the bond, which was on Monday. However, it managed to pay the interest. The original issue was $40 million but Gatic had bought back $3 million of it before maturity.
